This indirect evidence - from matter spiraling into the black hole or from the accretion disk - can provide valuable information about magnetic field behavior over time without requiring actual visual images of the black hole itself.

The second statement correctly acknowledges that no actual images have been obtained while describing the legitimate scientific methods that can be used to study black hole environments.
